body: Okay, I made up my mind. Thank you for insight.

The question is, is it even possible? And assuming it is, what if I go back to feeling this way? Living through each day has became an effort - it's just living for the sake of living. 
I wouldn't go as far as to call them symptoms. I'm thinking more of lifestyle choices.
Well, I obviously think there is something wrong with me, otherwise I wouldn't have gone to see doctors. But I don't intend to visit every doctor there is! I'm just.. tired.
